hero.headline: Weather forecasts. Compared in one place.
hero.subheadline: Compare 3 trusted weather forecasts for 120+ cities worldwide — plus monthly climate, the best time to visit and trip planning.
hero.locationDenied: We couldn't access your location. You can search for a city instead.

home.whyCompareBody: Different forecast providers use different weather models, data sources and update schedules — so their predictions can vary, especially several days out. Comparing them side by side gives you more context before you make a decision, without claiming any single source is guaranteed to be right.

search.noResults: No locations found. Try another search.

comparison.title: Forecast Comparison
comparison.subtitle: See how independent weather sources forecast the same location right now.

map.title: Weather map

footer.tagline: Weather information, compared in one place.
footer.notMeteorologicalAuthority: WeatherCompare aggregates and compares data from third-party weather providers and is not a meteorological authority. For official warnings, always check your national weather service.

cookieConsent.title: We value your privacy
cookieConsent.body: We use cookies to run this site and, with your permission, to understand how it's used. You can change your preferences at any time.
cookieConsent.necessaryDesc: Required for the site to function. Always on.
cookieConsent.analyticsDesc: Helps us understand how the site is used, in aggregate.
cookieConsent.advertisingDesc: Used to show relevant ads once monetization is enabled.
cookieConsent.preferencesDesc: Remembers choices like language, units and theme.

locate.title: See the weather where you are?
locate.text: Allow location access and we'll open the forecast for your area straight away. We only use it to find your city.
locate.denied: We couldn't get your location. You can search for a city instead.
